target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, one vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard/tablet, VirtIO sound WAV backend
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -audiodev wav,id=sound0,path=build/juke-puppet-current-4ba.wav -device virtio-sound-pci,audiodev=sound0,streams=1' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-juke-puppet-current-4ba.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-system-context --demo-system-path /Apps/Psalmody/JukePuppet.ZC --demo-system-module /Apps/Psalmody/Load.ZC
result: JukeSongsPuppet returned to the graphical terminal and the guest compiler remained healthy; song playback was not audible in the captured QEMU WAV
verified: The disposable guest received the stock childish.ZC song fixture, and JukeBox enumerated it through the .ZC mask.
The exact loaded JukeSongsPuppet path returned and printed juke-puppet-returned=42; afterward the graphical terminal evaluated 40+2 as 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
The WAV backend produced only 0.04 seconds of stereo PCM with zero nonzero samples, so this run does not prove the song started or produced sound.
scope_note: Automated QEMU only; this is not a visible UTM-window or physical Pi acceptance. It closes the function-return ambiguity for this fixture but leaves actual JukePuppet playback and attributable audio open.
